blocks.text: This article provides a summary of all new features and enhancements per Zscaler cloud for Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX). Zscaler will email a notification to your organization's registered support contacts approximately one week before your cloud is upgraded. To see scheduled maintenance updates for your cloud, visit the Trust Portal.

Compare two time points in the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page to view differences in ZDX Score data. The feature utilizes web, device, and cloud path metrics to help determine differences in scoring.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

blocks.heading: Depiction of Disabled and Deleted Applications and Probes

blocks.text: The distinction between disabled and deleted applications and probes in the ZDX Admin Portal UI has been updated. Disabled application and probe names are indicated in grey, and deleted application names are indicated via strikethrough.
See image.
To learn more, see About the ZDX Dashboard and About the Applications Dashboard.

blocks.heading: Device Time Zone in Hop View

blocks.text: Upon hover, the device profile in the Cloud Path Hop View includes the Device Time Zone.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

View current and historical information about software versions and updates on user devices, as well as current information about the devices and associated users. You can access Software Inventory and Device Inventory in the Inventory menu.
See image.
In order to view Inventory data, you must enable Inventory Data Collection under the Inventory Settings in the Administration menu and run Zscaler Client Connector version 3.3 or later for Windows.
See image.
To learn more, see About Software Inventory, About Device Inventory, and Configuring Inventory Settings. Contact your Zscaler Account Manager to request access to this feature.
You can assign granular permissions for your Help Desk roles with the updated permissions levels on the Add ZDX Role window.
If an admin has obfuscation assigned and is unable to see the required information, review the obfuscation settings in the permissions levels.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles, About ZDX Service Desk Role, and About ZDX Role-based Administration.
You can create or manage an API key on the API Key Management page.
See image.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to request access to this feature.
To learn more, see About API Key Management.

blocks.heading: ServiceNow Incident Management Integration with ZDX

blocks.text: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) supports the integration of ServiceNow Incident Management in a ServiceNow instance to automatically create incidents when alerts are triggered.
See image.
To learn more about ServiceNow Incident Management, see the ServiceNow Store.
To learn more about webhook configuration for ServiceNow Incident Management, see Configuring Webhooks for ServiceNow.
You can view alert statuses on the Alerts page.
See image.
To learn more, see Understanding the Alert Status.

blocks.heading: Default Packet Count for Cloud Path Probes

blocks.text: The default packet count for new cloud path probes has been updated from 11 to 5 for predefined and custom applications for all subscription levels.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring a Probe and Editing a Probe.

blocks.heading: Time Range Analysis for Poor ZDX Scores

blocks.text: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) helps identify potential reasons for Poor ZDX Scores within a specified time range. Click Analyze Range within the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page to view contributing factors and explanations.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

blocks.heading: Monitoring Criteria for ZDX Call Quality Applications

blocks.text: When adding a new tenant in Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Call Quality applications for Microsoft Teams and Zoom, Monitoring Criteria filters are now provided to help identify users who are meeting hosts. Only meetings hosted by these users are monitored.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Microsoft Teams Call Quality for ZDX and Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

Digital Experience (ZDX) can now help identify potential reasons for a Poor ZDX Score at a specific date and time. Click Analyze Score within the ZDX Score Over Time graph on the user details page to view factors and explanations for the low score.
See image.
To learn more, see Evaluating User Details.

blocks.heading: Admin Access to Zscaler Client Connector Portal

blocks.text: You can now configure admin permissions for Zscaler Client Connector Portal access by using the Add ZDX Role pop-up in Role Management.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) now supports the use of APIs for programmatic access to ZDX data. This allows you to integrate analytics tools and ITSM solutions. API access requires an API key to authenticate in order to retrieve data.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to request access to the API Key Management feature.
To learn more, see About the ZDX API and About API Key Management.

blocks.heading: Device Location Icon in Hop View

blocks.text: The cloud path hop view now displays an icon to indicate a device location was determined by latitude and longitude coordinates, rather than IP address.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
The cloud path now displays underlay hops to show the routing path for GRE tunnels.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

blocks.heading: ZIA Private Service Edge in Cloud Path

blocks.text: The Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) Private Service Edge is now displayed in the cloud path hop view for private networks.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
You can now configure UCaaS Monitoring permissions for access to Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) Call Quality applications.
See image.
To learn more, see Adding ZDX Roles.

A Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) score baseline is now provided in the Page Fetch Time graph on the user details page. For predefined applications, the baseline represents an average score based on device metrics across all organizations. For custom applications, the baseline represents an average score based on device metrics from a given organization.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
The Cloud Path Hop View now shows the grouping of protocol with tunnel type for Adaptive probes.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.
The Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) cloud path now supports No Default Route (NDR) deployments to the Zscaler cloud.

On the User Overview page, messaging has been added to the end of trend lines for Total Active Users and Total Active Devices for the last few minutes if complete data is not yet available from all connected devices.
See image.
To learn more, see About the Users Dashboard.

blocks.heading: Support for ZPA Private Service Edge and Web Probe Rate Limiting

blocks.text: Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) now supports Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Private Service Edge in the cloud path and web probe rate limits for internal applications through ZPA. The following versions are required for this ZPA support:

blocks.item: Windows: Zscaler Client Connector 3.7.1 (with ZDX Module 3.1 for Windows)
macOS: Zscaler Client Connector 3.6 (with ZDX Module 3.1 for macOS)

blocks.text: To learn more about ZPA in the cloud path and rate limiting, see About the Users Dashboard and About ZDX Web Probe Rate Limiting.

Zscaler Digital Experience (ZDX) now supports Zoom Call Quality to monitor calls or meetings among two or more participants in a configured Zoom tenant. The user and device information for call participants is mapped directly to ZDX users and devices. Call Quality works in parallel with cloud path probes and device metrics and events to help you identify issues that are unique to a device, application, or network.
Zoom Call Quality is currently limited by the Zoom API rate limit of 60K probes per day, and may be affected by other Zoom applications using the API.
See image.
To learn more, see Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX and About Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

As part of the Standard subscription plan, ZDX supports an onboarding wizard for Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) admins who have full admin and policy access to quickly enable the ZDX service. The wizard also allows admins to add the ZDX admin role to other existing ZIA admins or to new admins. This wizard is now fully supported on all Zscaler clouds for ZIA.
See image.
To learn more, see Using the ZDX Setup Wizard and About Notification.
